verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a built-in AI assistant in the AWS console or CLI that users can hand tasks to. Bedrock and AgentCore are platforms for developers to build and deploy their own agents, and the awslabs MCP servers let external agents connect to AWS. Both are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
